BrochureContent.Content:
O'Donnellan & Joyce are delighted to offer for sale Cnoc Mhuire, 36 College Road, a substantial five-bedroom semi-detached residence occupying a superb position on one of Galway City's most established and sought-after residential areas.

Extending to approximately 201 sq.m., the property offers generous accommodation, excellent proportions and a versatile layout, providing a superb canvas for those looking to create a substantial family home in an unrivalled city location.

Built circa 1946 and updated over the years, the accommodation currently comprises five bedrooms, three bathrooms, generous reception space, a kitchen, sunroom and additional dining area. 

Externally, the property benefits from a private rear yard and garage, adding further appeal and off-street parking.

The real highlight of Cnoc Mhuire is undoubtedly its exceptional location. Situated on College Road, the property is within easy walking distance of Galway City Centre, Eyre Square and the vibrant Latin Quarter, with an outstanding selection of shops, cafés, bars and restaurants all close by. 

The area also offers easy access to some of Galway's most scenic amenities, including Lough Atalia, the Corrib Walkway, Spanish Arch and Galway Cathedral.

The property is ideally positioned opposite the Dexcom Galway Sportsgrounds and is within a short walk of Galway's main bus and train stations, making it particularly attractive for those seeking the convenience of city living. 

University of Galway, University Hospital Galway and ATU Galway are all readily accessible, while excellent transport links provide easy access to surrounding employment hubs and business parks.

For families, investors or purchasers seeking a property in a prime Galway City location, 36 College Road offers enormous potential. Properties offering this combination of size, location and scope rarely come to market.

An excellent opportunity to acquire a substantial city residence with the potential to create a superb home in one of Galway's most desirable locations. 

Viewing is highly recommended and guaranteed not to disappoint.
